title: Application of Eastern Edison Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 131, for approval by the Department of change in the Company's oil Conservation Adjustment charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings taken in the billing months of September, October and November, 1987.The Oil Conservation kAdjustment surcharge is designed to recover the cost of conversion from all-fired to coal-fired generation and its calculation is based on the respective costs of burning coal and oil.
